; Proposed edb79dae-inspired family. Materialize the hop bound as 1 or 9.
; The template always belongs to the ORIGINAL block color. Nine steps reach
; the terminal color in the admitted acyclic ARC-palette mapping grammar.
(rule!
 (lambda (g)
   (define frequency (color-frequency g))
   (define maximum-frequency (apply max (hash-values frequency)))
   (define backgrounds
     (filter (lambda (c) (= (hash-ref frequency c) maximum-frequency))
             (hash-keys frequency)))
   (unless (= (length backgrounds) 1)
     (error "legend-templates: background mode must be unique"))
   (define bg (first backgrounds))
   (define components (objects g bg))
   (define frames
     (filter
      (lambda (o)
        (and (>= (obj-h o) 5) (>= (obj-w o) 5)
             (= (obj-size o) (- (* 2 (+ (obj-h o) (obj-w o))) 4))
             (for/and ([p (in-list (obj-cells o))])
               (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 o)) (= (first p) (obj-r2 o))
                   (= (second p) (obj-c1 o)) (= (second p) (obj-c2 o))))))
      components))
   (unless (= (length frames) 1)
     (error "legend-templates: expected one complete hollow frame"))
   (define frame (first frames))
   (define fr (obj-r1 frame))
   (define fc (obj-c1 frame))
   (define lr (obj-r2 frame))
   (define lc (obj-c2 frame))
   (define frame-color (obj-color frame))
   (define (outside-frame? r c)
     (not (and (<= fr r lr) (<= fc c lc))))
   (define arrows
     (for*/list ([r (in-range (- (rows g) 2))]
                 [c (in-range (- (cols g) 3))]
                 #:when
                 (let ([s (cell-at g r c)] [t (cell-at g r (+ c 3))])
                   (and (not (= s t))
                        (not (member s (list bg frame-color)))
                        (not (member t (list bg frame-color)))
                        (for*/and ([dr (in-range 3)] [dc (in-range 4)])
                          (and (outside-frame? (+ r dr) (+ c dc))
                               (= (cell-at g (+ r dr) (+ c dc))
                                  (if (or (< dc 2) (and (= dr 1) (= dc 2)))
                                      s t)))))))
       (list r c (cell-at g r c) (cell-at g r (+ c 3)))))
   (when (empty? arrows) (error "legend-templates: missing arrows"))
   (define excluded (make-hash))
   (define mapping (make-hash))
   (for ([a (in-list arrows)])
     (define s (third a))
     (define t (fourth a))
     (when (and (hash-has-key? mapping s) (not (= (hash-ref mapping s) t)))
       (error "legend-templates: conflicting arrows"))
     (hash-set! mapping s t)
     (for* ([dr (in-range 3)] [dc (in-range 4)])
       (hash-set! excluded (list (+ (first a) dr) (+ (second a) dc)) #t)))
   (define external (make-hash))
   (for* ([r (in-range (rows g))] [c (in-range (cols g))])
     (define v (cell-at g r c))
     (when (and (outside-frame? r c)
                (not (= v bg)) (not (= v frame-color))
                (not (hash-has-key? excluded (list r c))))
       (hash-update! external v (lambda (points) (cons (list r c) points)) '())))
   (define templates (make-hash))
   (for ([(color points) (in-hash external)])
     (define top (apply min (map first points)))
     (define left (apply min (map second points)))
     (hash-set! templates color
                (for/list ([p (in-list points)])
                  (list (- (first p) top) (- (second p) left)))))
   (define blocks
     (filter (lambda (o)
               (and (< fr (obj-r1 o)) (< (obj-r2 o) lr)
                    (< fc (obj-c1 o)) (< (obj-c2 o) lc)
                    (= (obj-h o) (obj-w o))
                    (= (obj-size o) (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o)))))
             components))
   (define (mapped-color original)
     (let walk ([color original] [remaining 1])
       (if (or (zero? remaining) (not (hash-has-key? mapping color)))
           color
           (walk (hash-ref mapping color) (sub1 remaining)))))
   (define painted (make-hash))
   (for ([block (in-list blocks)])
     (define original (obj-color block))
     (unless (and (hash-has-key? templates original)
                  (hash-has-key? mapping original))
       (error "legend-templates: block lacks original template or arrow"))
     (define mask (hash-ref templates original))
     (unless (and (= (add1 (apply max (map first mask))) (obj-h block))
                  (= (add1 (apply max (map second mask))) (obj-w block)))
       (error "legend-templates: template and square sizes differ"))
     (define target (mapped-color original))
     (for* ([dr (in-range (obj-h block))] [dc (in-range (obj-w block))])
       (hash-set! painted (list (+ (obj-r1 block) dr) (+ (obj-c1 block) dc))
                  (if (member (list dr dc) mask) target bg))))
   (grid-from-fn (obj-h frame) (obj-w frame)
     (lambda (r c)
       (define source-r (+ fr r))
       (define source-c (+ fc c))
       (hash-ref painted (list source-r source-c)
                 (lambda () (cell-at g source-r source-c)))))))
